crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound…
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will…
“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind…
Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

translations.web: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
translations.bsb: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God,
translations.kjv: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,
translations.asv: Then Jonah prayed unto Jehovah his God out of the fish's belly.
